reviews.text:
Yes, ALL the reviews are true!!!! Larry is amazing at his craft! His suite is private, welcoming, calming, quiet, clean and such a vibe. I felt safe, respected and soooooo relaxed! He checked in with me about pressure points and made sure I was comfortable.. I didn’t feel rushed at all..

Throughout the massage he used a warm soft towel (felt like butter) and had plenty of options on scents of his oils… I can tell he is educated and truly knows what he is doing!

I booked a 2 hour massage and he massaged me the entire time!

His hospitality and “customer service” was absolutely FLAWLESS!!!!!!!! ✨✨Lastly, his prices are budget friendly and  I am now a repeat faithful client. THIS IS WHAT A TRUE RELAXING MASSAGE EXPERIENCE SHOULD BE!! I can’t brag enough about him!
reviews.author: Ashley Brown

reviews.text: I went to essence of serenity at the beginning of February and it was one of the best experiences I’ve ever had. I was feeling really tight after a lot of lifting and Larry did an unbelievable job. Even though I booked a regular massage, he incorporated some deep tissue massaging into my really sore areas. Larry was so kind and so professional and made sure that you had a great experience. I will absolutely be returning.
reviews.author: Veronica Wilson

reviews.text:
This was my second visit to Essence of Serenity, and once again Larry completely exceeded my expectations. I had a full two-hour, full-body massage, and it was truly one of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had.

My back was especially angry and full of knots, and Larry made sure to spend extra time working through those areas while still giving attention to my entire body. His pressure was spot-on, he checked in throughout the session, and everything felt unhurried and incredibly thoughtful. I walked out feeling relaxed, loose, and so much better than when I arrived.

If you’re looking for a full-body massage where the therapist genuinely listens and tailors the session to your needs, Larry is amazing. This is exactly why I came back—and I’ll definitely be returning again.
reviews.author: Lauren Vainberg

reviews.text: Larry was incredible! I did the 1.5 hour massage, and it was just what I needed to de-stress after the holidays. He is kind, communicative, and really cares about the experience his clients have while in his care. His prices are also unbeatable! I will definitely be back for the 2 hour massage in the future. Best massage I have ever gotten before, hands down!
reviews.author: Mari

reviews.text: I received a gift certificate for a 2 hour massage. It was easy to book on the website and Larry was very responsive to my emails. This was my first time having such a long session, but I was so relaxed and comfortable, the two hours flew by. The ambiance and the space is zen and Larry is very professional and respectful in doing what is most comfortable for the client. His prices are very reasonable, so you can add self care into your routine. I highly recommend and Larry and will return.
reviews.author: Grace Van
